fields.description: Issue includes editorials and columns on Miami and Miami Beach civic affairs, including criticism of the Florida Power & Light bus agreement and discussion of taxes, assessments, and poll tax/registration. Contains commentary on tourism and pricing, Prohibition-era liquor prices, and local civic groups (e.g., Lions Club and Community Chest). Features local humor/columns ("They Tell Me," "Little Geraldine"), a satirical report about West Central Miami voting to eliminate summer from the calendar, and a news item about a Florida Power & Light meter-reader ("Hammerhead Greeby") arrested over empty fire extinguishers. Includes numerous local advertisements and legal notices.
